papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Air pollution plays a critical role in disease progression and acute exacerbations of COPD (AECOPD). However, the interaction between air pollution and infectious pathogens in triggering AECOPD remains incompletely understood. We investigated associations between air pollution levels and specific respiratory pathogens in patients with AECOPD. METHODS: We conducted a multicentre retrospective cohort study of 657 patients with moderate-to-severe AECOPD between 2015 and 2019. Air pollutant data and respiratory viral pathogen data were analysed using Spearman correlation, dynamic time warping and Poisson regression models with lagged variables to assess both temporal similarity and short-term exposure effects. RESULTS: Spearman correlation analysis showed that influenza virus (IFV) and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) were positively correlated with particulate matter with aerodynamic diameter <2.5 µm (PM2.5) and nitrate (NO3 -). Parainfluenza virus was positively correlated with sulfate (SO4 2-) and negatively correlated with NO3 -. Dynamic time warping analysis demonstrated strong seasonal synchronisation between air pollutants and IFV and rhinovirus (RV). In Poisson regression models, a 1-μg·m-3 increase in PM2.5 was associated with an 8.0% increase in RV incidence (p=0.013) and a 6.2% increase in IFV incidence (p=0.032). By contrast, RSV incidence decreased by 13.0% per 0.1-ppb increase in SO4 2- (p=0.040). CONCLUSIONS: Air pollution shows association with viral-induced AECOPD, with the magnitude and direction of effects varying by pollutant, viral pathogen and temporal context.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Type 2 inflammation and upper gastrointestinal symptom traits are common in chronic cough but their relationship with cough resolution in practice remains unclear. METHODS: This retrospective study included 256 patients with chronic cough followed up for ≥3 months between 2012 and 2020. Type 2 inflammation was defined as peripheral blood eosinophils ≥300 cells·μL-1, fractional exhaled nitric oxide ≥25 ppb or serum total IgE ≥100 IU·mL-1. Reflux symptoms (RS) and dysmotility symptoms (DS) were assessed using the modified Frequency Scale for the Symptoms of Gastro-oesophageal Reflux Disease. Severe RS was defined as RS >7 and DS >1 was considered a dysmotility-related symptom trait. Time to physician-assessed cough resolution was evaluated using Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox proportional hazards models. RESULTS: Patients with severe RS had a longer median time to cough resolution than those with nonsevere RS (3.8 versus 2.0 months) and a higher 12-month rate of unresolved cough (20.3% versus 16.3%; p<0.05). Among patients with severe RS, those without type 2 inflammation had a higher 12-month rate of unresolved cough than those with type 2 inflammation (28.5% versus 13.3%; p<0.01). In the nonsevere RS subgroup, patients with a dysmotility-related symptom trait had a lower 12-month rate of unresolved cough than those without this trait (10.7% versus 24.1%; p<0.01). In multivariable Cox analysis, type 2 inflammation was associated with a greater likelihood of cough resolution, whereas severe RS was associated with delayed cough resolution. CONCLUSION: Type 2 inflammation and severe RS were independently associated with physician-assessed cough resolution. Dysmotility-related symptoms may characterise heterogeneity within RS-defined subgroups.

papers.authors: Wu F, Huang S, Xi Y, Tai J, Deng Z, Wu X, Wang H, Zhou Y et al.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a heterogeneous condition but current biomarker-based classifications remain insufficient. Although dysregulation of the monocyte-macrophage axis has been implicated in COPD, the genetic and prognostic associations between peripheral monocyte indices and distinct disease phenotypes have not been fully characterized. METHODS: This study used cross-sectional and longitudinal data from the ECOPD cohort (n=2022) along with multi-trait genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to evaluate the associations between peripheral monocyte counts and COPD clinical features, as well as 3-year outcomes. Genetic analyses included cross-trait linkage disequilibrium score regression (LDSC) to estimate genetic correlations, and bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) utilizing GWAS summary statistics for monocyte indices, COPD risk, and lung function traits. Multi-trait colocalization analysis (COLOC) was performed to identify shared causal variants, while transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS) were conducted using expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) from blood and lung tissue. Multi-trait analysis of GWAS (MTAG) was used to detect pleiotropic loci, followed by eQTL-informed MR and cohort-level validation to prioritize candidate genes. RESULTS: Higher monocyte counts were significantly associated with greater dyspnea severity (mMRC β=0.26, p=0.001), accelerated decline in lung function (post-FVC β= -27.51 mL/year, p<0.05), and increased risk of severe exacerbations (RR=3.80, P<0.001). Genetic analyses revealed shared heritability between monocyte indices and both COPD susceptibility and lung function decline. However, Mendelian randomization analyses provided limited, direction specific evidence. TWAS revealed convergence of biological pathways linked to monocyte indices and COPD phenotypes across blood and lung tissues. PRSS16 emerged as a prioritized gene potentially mediating monocyte-related susceptibility to COPD. CONCLUSION: Peripheral monocyte indices are significantly associated with COPD severity and disease progression. Although causal inferences remain unconfirmed, genetic evidence supports shared architecture and common biological mechanisms. The identification of pleiotropic loci also indicates that PRSS16 is a candidate gene worthy of functional validation.

papers.title_zh: 全球COPD归因于环境臭氧污染的疾病负担、至2035年预测及社会经济不平等（GBD 2021）：负担总量大但年龄标化率下降、绝对数上升
papers.title_en: Global Trends, Projections, and Socioeconomic Disparities in COPD Burden Attributable to Ambient Ozone Pollution: Estimates from the Global Burden of Disease Study 2021.
papers.authors: Tong E, Chen Y, Li W, Zhang F, Krafft T
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Health, Ethics and Society, Care and Public Health Research Institute (CAPHRI), Maastricht University, Maa…
papers.results: 2021年全球环境臭氧污染归因COPD死亡489,519例、DALY 877万（8.77 million）例；1990–2021年年龄标化死亡率与DALY率下降而绝对数上升；负担在男性、老年人及中低SDI地区更高；分解分析显示人口老龄化是绝对负担上升的主要贡献因素；不平等分析提示2021年臭氧归因COPD负担较1990年更集中于低SDI国家和地区；BAPC预测至2035年年龄标化死亡率中位数略有下降、年龄标化DALY率中位数略有上升，可信区间宽
papers.authors_conclusion: 全球归因于环境臭氧污染的COPD负担依然庞大且分布不均；这些发现提示未来空气污染控制与COPD防控策略应考虑人口老龄化和社会经济不平等；这些人群层面的模型化估计应结合GBD假设与不确定性加以解读
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未给出任何效应量的具体点估计与95%CI/P值（仅'略有升降''可信区间宽'的定性描述），无法评估趋势与不平等差异的统计学意义；'不平等加剧'仅用'suggested'表述，未报告SII/集中指数的数值及检验；臭氧-COPD归因依赖GBD比较风险评估的暴露-反应关系假设，而该假设本身基于有限研究，存在归因偏倚风险；预测中死亡率降而DALY率升的背离未提供解释；研究为生态学模型化数据，不能外推至个体临床决策

pico.p: 1990–2021年全球204个国家和地区人群（GBD 2021数据）
pico.ic: 无干预；为归因暴露比较（环境臭氧污染归因的COPD死亡与DALY），含1990 vs 2021趋势比较及2035年BAPC预测

papers.reason: 为COPD环境危险因素的人群层面研究提供负担基线与2035年预测参照，可用于呼吸疾病负担课题的队列背景与公共卫生策略论证；对胸外科/胸部肿瘤临床决策直接影响有限
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) remains a major global health burden. Ambient ozone pollution is an important but comparatively underexamined environmental risk factor for COPD, particularly among ageing populations and socioeconomically disadvantaged regions. METHODS: Using Global Burden of Disease 2021 data, we assessed COPD deaths and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) attributable to ambient ozone pollution across 204 countries and territories from 1990 to 2021. We estimated temporal trends using the estimated annual percentage change, decomposed changes in absolute burden into contributions from population growth, population ageing, and epidemiological change, examined socioeconomic inequality using the slope index of inequality and concentration index, and projected future trends to 2035 using a Bayesian age-period-cohort model. RESULTS: In 2021, ambient ozone pollution was associated with an estimated 489,519 deaths and 8.77 million DALYs from COPD globally. Although age-standardized mortality and DALY rates declined from 1990 to 2021, absolute numbers increased. The burden was higher among males, older adults, and low-middle SDI regions. Decomposition analysis indicated that population ageing was the main contributor to the increase in absolute burden. Inequality analyses suggested a greater concentration of ozone-attributable COPD burden in countries and territories with lower SDI in 2021 than in 1990. BAPC projections suggested a slight decrease in median age-standardized mortality rates and a slight increase in median age-standardized DALY rates by 2035, with wide credible intervals. CONCLUSION: The global COPD burden attributable to ambient ozone pollution remains substantial and unevenly distributed. These findings suggest that demographic ageing and socioeconomic inequality should be considered in future air pollution control and COPD prevention strategies. These population-level modelled estimates should be interpreted alongside GBD assumptions and uncertainty.

papers.title_en: A divergent bat orthopneumovirus with zoonotic potential constrained by RSV adaptive immunity and broad-spectrum treatment.
papers.authors: Jo WK, Haid S, Binger T, Brünink S, Dei D, Drosten C, Kühne A, Müller J et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Institute of Virology, Charité - Universitätsmedizin Berlin, corporate member of Freie Universität Berlin and Humboldt U…
papers.results: 蝙蝠流行病学：RT-PCR阳性24/1778，IgG IFA阳性6/66；两个BPV遗传变异近全基因组显示典型正肺病毒基因组结构但缺SH孔蛋白基因；BPV NS1/NS2可拮抗人干扰素β反应；BPV假病毒进入人细胞效率较RSV低4.5至53.5倍；BPV可被人RSV反应性抗血清交叉中和；BPV逃逸RSV特异性治疗抗体帕利珠单抗的中和及lonafarnib的抑制，但对靶向保守抗原位点III的广谱单抗MPE8仍敏感
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings identify zoonotic traits of a divergent bat pneumovirus while suggesting potential protective value of preexisting RSV immunity and broad-spectrum interventions, which has implications for pandemic preparedness. Whether cross-protection in the human population may change by the advent of RSV vaccination warrants investigation.
papers.ai_note: 人畜共患风险完全基于体外替代指标（假病毒进入、交叉中和、干扰素拮抗），摘要未报告任何人间感染病例或流行病学证据；'受RSV适应性免疫约束'的结论依赖人RSV反应性抗血清的体外交叉中和，人群实际保护水平信息不足；血清阳性样本仅6/66、基因组仅2例，外推性有限；标题与摘要对'zoonotic potential'的强调程度超出证据强度；RSV疫苗普及后交叉保护是否改变被作者列为待研究，属信息不足

pico.ic: BPV与RSV假病毒进入人细胞效率比较；BPV对RSV特异性帕利珠单抗、lonafarnib及广谱单抗MPE8的中和/抑制敏感性比较（体外功能实验，非临床干预）

papers.reason: 为呼吸道病毒大流行防备与广谱抗病毒/疫苗研发提供蝙蝠宿主病毒的基线表征数据，可作为胸部肿瘤患者呼吸道病毒易感性与RSV免疫背景讨论的外围参考，不直接影响胸外科或胸部肿瘤临床决策
papers.abstract_en: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV; genus Orthopneumovirus) causes severe pneumonia in young children worldwide, yet the zoonotic potential of the few known nonhuman animal orthopneumoviruses remains unknown. Here, we characterized a highly divergent bat orthopneumovirus (BPV) from West African straw-colored fruit bats and established a systematic framework for evaluating zoonotic risk posed by an emerging viral pathogen. Epidemiologic data in bats showed a low viral detection rate (24 of 1778 RT-PCR positive) and low seroprevalence (6 of 66 IgG IFA positive), suggesting BPV episodic circulation potentially sustained in immunologically naïve bats following bat birthing events. Near-complete genomes from two BPV genetic variants revealed prototypic orthopneumovirus organization, but lacked the SH viroporin-encoding gene present in RSV. Functional experiments showed that BPV NS1/NS2 antagonized human interferon β responses, and that BPV pseudoviruses entered human cells (4.5- to 53.5-fold less efficiently than RSV), while being cross-neutralized by human RSV-reactive antisera, together suggesting zoonotic traits that may be partly constrained by cross-protective immunity. BPV escaped neutralization by RSV-specific therapeutic palivizumab and inhibition by lonafarnib, but remained susceptible to MPE8, a broad-spectrum monoclonal antibody that targets the conserved pneumovirus antigenic site III. These findings identify zoonotic traits of a divergent bat pneumovirus while suggesting potential protective value of preexisting RSV immunity and broad-spectrum interventions, which has implications for pandemic preparedness. Whether cross-protection in the human population may change by the advent of RSV vaccination warrants investigation. Efforts to investigate orthopneumovirus host shifts, reservoir studies, and development of broadly reactive orthopneumovirus vaccines and antivirals are warranted.

papers.authors: Salo PM, Wilkerson J, McNeley SAM, Mendy A, Fessler MB, Thorne PS, Zeldin DC
papers.affiliation_highlight: Division of Intramural Research, National Institute of Environmental Health Sciences, National Institutes of Health, 111…
papers.results: 现患哮喘比例8.9%；现患哮喘者中17.7%报告过去12个月哮喘相关急诊就诊。烟草烟雾与高环境NO2联合暴露与哮喘急诊就诊几率升高相关 [OR=2.78, 95%CI:1.11-6.92]，但仅见于儿童。PM2.5或O3未见加性交互作用；烟草烟雾与高PM2.5联合暴露在儿童中与哮喘急诊就诊相关（OR=2.92, 95%CI:1.13-7.56）。

These findings underscore the importance of reducing both TS and ambient air pollution exposures to reduce the burden of asthma, especially in children.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Tobacco smoke (TS) exposure and ambient air pollution are important triggers of asthma exacerbations, but their combined effects remain poorly understood. We investigated whether co-exposure to TS and ambient air pollutants was associated with asthma exacerbations in the U.S. METHODS: We analyzed data from 5,780 participants aged ≥ 3 years in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey 2005-2006. Ambient fine particulate matter (PM2.5), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), and ozone (O3) exposures were estimated using the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency Community Multiscale Air Quality modeling system. Serum cotinine was used as a biomarker of TS exposure. Asthma exacerbations were assessed by self-reports of asthma-related emergency care visits in the previous 12 months. Multivariable logistic regression models were used to examine associations between asthma exacerbations and co-exposures to the air pollutants and to assess additive interactions. RESULTS: Among participants with current asthma (8.9%), 17.7% reported asthma-related emergency care visits. Co-exposure to TS and elevated ambient NO2 levels was associated with higher odds of asthma emergency care visits [odds ratio (OR) = 2.78, 95% CI:1.11-6.92] but only among children. Although no additive interactions were identified for PM2.5 or O3, TS and elevated PM2.5 co-exposure was associated with asthma visits among children (OR = 2.92, 95% CI:1.13-7.56). CONCLUSIONS: Co-exposure to TS and ambient air pollution (elevated NO2, PM2.5) was associated with asthma-related emergency care visits among U.S. children. These findings underscore the importance of reducing both TS and ambient air pollution exposures to reduce the burden of asthma, especially in children.

papers.title_en: Decoding immune signatures driving brain metastases in stage III non-small cell lung cancer.
papers.authors: Najjary S, Vadgama D, Kros JM, von der Thüsen JH, Ruysscher D, Groen H, Belderbos J, Bootsma GG et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pathology and Clinical Bioinformatics, The Tumor Immuno-Pathology Laboratory, Erasmus University Medical C…
papers.results: 组织样本208/636例接受评估（排除：n=329非原发样本、n=99组织不可用、n=166 RNA不足、n=1重复样本），最终纳入41例（BM 11例，OOM 30例）。BM组原发灶肥大细胞基因特征表达升高；DSP分析显示BM组肿瘤浸润区域CD14、FOXP3、BCL-2蛋白表达更高。摘要未报告任何效应量、P值或95%CI。
papers.authors_conclusion: These findings identify immune features of primary NSCLC associated with subsequent BM development and warrant validation in larger independent cohorts.
papers.ai_note: ①纳入率极低：636例中仅41例（6.4%）进入最终分析，组织可及性与RNA质量导致的大规模损耗带来明显选择偏倚风险，摘要未比较纳入与排除患者的基线特征。②对照组为OOM而非无转移人群，所识别特征可能反映一般转移倾向而非脑转移特异性（脑趋向性），但标题使用‘driving’的因果措辞。③360基因面板的探索性多重比较未说明校正方法，且摘要通篇无P值、CI或效应量，‘elevated/higher’均为定性表述，统计学可靠性无法评估。④DSP验证样本量仅BM=6 vs OOM=10，远不足以确证。⑤信息不足：无患者临床结局（脑转移发生率、潜伏期）及多因素校正信息。

papers.reason: 为III期NSCLC根治治疗后脑转移风险预测的原发灶免疫标志物（肥大细胞特征、CD14/FOXP3/BCL-2）提供最初假设，影响后续验证队列的靶点选择与研究设计；同时其低纳入率与对照设置为评估该类生物标志物研究的偏倚风险提供反面参照。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Development of brain metastasis (BM) during follow-up remains challenging in radically treated stage III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC). Characterizing the molecular and immunological landscape of primary tumors may provide insight into factors associated with subsequent BM development. We performed comparative targeted gene expression profiles in primary tumors from patients with radically treated stage III NSCLC who developed BM versus those with other organ metastases (OOM). METHODS: Exploratory analysis of two prospective studies (NVALT-11 [NCT01282437], NL3335) and one retrospective series including patients with adequately staged and radically treated stage III NSCLC. Available baseline FFPE biopsies of the primary (stage III NSCLC diagnosis) were collected. PanCancer IO 360™ Panel was utilized to measure gene expression profiles. Targeted gene expression analysis was performed using NanoString Technology. In-depth multiplex protein spatial measurements in independent NSCLC samples (BM = 6 and OOM = 10) was performed using GeoMx™ Digital Spatial Profiler (DSP) profiling. RESULTS: Tissue samples of 208/636 patients were evaluated (excluded: n = 329 non-primary samples and n = 99 tissue unavailable). Additionally, 166 samples were excluded because of insufficient RNA, and 1 sample was excluded because it was a duplicate. A total of 41 samples were included (11 BM, 30 OOM). We revealed elevated expression of a mast cell gene-signature in the primary of the BM-development group. With DSP profiling we identified higher expression of CD14, FOXP3, and BCL-2 proteins within tumor infiltrated regions of the BM group. CONCLUSIONS: These findings identify immune features of primary NSCLC associated with subsequent BM development and warrant validation in larger independent cohorts.

papers.abstract_en: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a life-threatening pulmonary disorder whose progression is closely associated with macrophage inflammatory activation and ferroptosis-related lipid peroxidation. However, current therapeutic strategies mainly target a single pathological process and are therefore insufficient to simultaneously regulate inflammation and ferroptosis. Here, a spermine-mediated Mg2 +-free tetrahedral framework nucleic acid (tFNA) nanoplatform, Spm-tFNA-A-siT, was constructed for the dual regulation of inflammation- and ferroptosis-associated pathological processes in ARDS. In this platform, spermine not only serves as an assembly mediator for DNA nanostructures, enabling tFNA formation under Mg2 +-free conditions and improving its physiological stability, but also functions as a bioactive molecule with anti-inflammatory and anti-ferroptotic effects. By integrating a TLR4 aptamer and TREM-1 siRNA, the platform enhances uptake by activated macrophages and enables TREM-1 gene silencing. At the molecular level, Spm-tFNA-A-siT suppresses TREM-1/NF-κB inflammatory signaling and restores the GPX4/SLC7A11 ferroptosis-defense axis, thereby concurrently alleviating inflammatory responses and lipid peroxidation injury. In an LPS-induced ARDS mouse model, Spm-tFNA-A-siT significantly reduced pulmonary edema, inflammatory cell infiltration, and lung tissue injury, while improving survival. Overall, this study establishes a functionalized DNA nanoplatform integrating Mg2 +-free DNA self-assembly, aptamer-enhanced macrophage uptake, and dual inflammation-ferroptosis regulation, providing a nanomedicine strategy with translational potential for ARDS therapy.

papers.title_en: Overnight changes in Cheyne-Stokes respiratory cycle characteristics and oxygen saturation in patients with heart failure and central sleep apnea.
papers.authors: Ishiwata S, Ryan CM, Horvath CM, Logan AG, Tomlinson G, Chavoshian S, Floras JS, Douglas Bradley T et al.

papers.authors_conclusion: 在HFrEF合并CSA患者中，CSR的CL与AL均与LFCT相关且三者夜间升高，提示循环时间的变化影响这些CSR周期特征。尽管AL夜间升高，平均与最低SaO2并未下降，可能与同时增加的高通气期呼吸次数有关。
papers.ai_note: 预设假设（后半段血氧下降更深）未获支持，属阴性结果；结论中以'高通气呼吸次数增加'作代偿性解释，属事后机制推测，摘要未给出该解释的统计学验证。仅选取N2期首末各10个CSR周期代表前后半夜，非全夜分析，且为相关性观察、不能推断因果。基于单夜基线数据，无法反映长期或治疗后变化。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The cycle length (CL) of Cheyne-Stokes respiration (CSR) in patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and central sleep apnea (CSA) relates inversely to cardiac output. CL can increase overnight. We hypothesized that a concurrent overnight increase in the duration of apnea (apnea length; AL) will cause greater dips in oxygen saturation in the second than the first half of the night. METHODS: Baseline polysomnograms of all 198 ADVENT-HF participants with CSA were analyzed. The first and last 10 CSR cycles (from the start of one apnea to that of the next) in stage N2 sleep were identified. We extracted CL, AL, and lung to finger circulation time (LFCT, from the end of an apnea to the subsequent SaO2 nadir detected by finger oximetry). We examined relationships between mean values for LFCT, CL and AL over all 20 cycles and then compared mean values for CSR-related characteristics calculated for the first and second half of the night. RESULTS: CL and AL correlated with LFCT (r2 = 0.50, p < 0.001 and r2 = 0.23, p < 0.001, respectively). There were overnight increases in CL (54.4 ± 15.7 vs 59.1 ± 16.6 s), AL (24.5 ± 6.9 vs 27.5 ± 8.8 s) and LFCT (28.9 ± 10.6 vs 30.9 ± 10.5 s, p < 0.001 for all), whereas neither minimum nor mean SaO2 changed (89.4 ± 4.1 vs 88.8 ± 4.8, p = 0.312 and 92.9 ± 2.5 vs 92.8 ± 2.7%, p = 0.589). Breaths during hyperpnea increased from the first to the second half of the night (9.2 ± 3.8 vs 9.8 ± 3.7 breaths, p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: In patients with HFrEF and CSA, both CSR CL and AL relate to LFCT, all of which increase overnight, suggesting that changes in circulation time influence these CSR cycle characteristics. Despite an overnight increase in AL, mean and minimum SaO2 did not fall, likely due to a concurrent increase in breaths/hyperpnea. CLINICAL TRIAL REGISTRATION: This trial was registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT01128816) and the International Standard Randomised Controlled Trial Number Register (ISRCTN67500535).

papers.results: 合并症组年龄更大，CRP、PCT、中性粒细胞计数与NLR更高，CT肺炎更常见，但双侧肺浸润比例更低；高血压独立关联更高logCRP与logNLR，肿瘤史关联更高logNLR（FDR校正P = 0.035），糖尿病关联更低logPCT；按基础疾病数量（0、1、≥2）分组，logCRP水平与CT异常发生率存在统计学显著差异，0至1种显著升高，1与≥2组之间无进一步升高；摘要未报告效应量、置信区间及临床结局数值

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The effect of comorbidity burden on inflammatory and imaging severity in respiratory tract infections remains unclear. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 911 adults with respiratory tract infections and compared inflammatory markers and chest CT findings according to underlying diseases. Multivariable regression adjusted for age, sex, pathogen type and peak fever. False discovery rate (FDR) correction was applied for multiple comparisons. RESULTS: Patients with comorbidities were older and showed higher CRP, PCT, neutrophil count and NLR, with more frequent CT pneumonia but a lower proportion of bilateral lung infiltrates. Hypertension was independently associated with higher logCRP and logNLR, tumour history with higher logNLR(FDR-adjusted P = 0.035), and diabetes with lower logPCT. When patients were grouped by the number of underlying diseases (0, 1, ≥ 2), we observed statistically significant differences in logCRP levels and the incidence of CT findings, with a significant increase from 0 to 1 comorbidity, but no further increase between the 1 and ≥ 2 groups. CONCLUSION: Comorbidity burden may support early risk stratification in respiratory tract infections. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Not applicable. This retrospective observational cohort study did not involve prospective assignment of participants to an intervention and therefore did not meet the definition of a clinical trial.

papers.authors: Shah PA, Israel E, Chupp G, Pavord I, Brightling C

papers.authors_conclusion: 本综述综合成功、失败与有害生物制剂干预的机制和临床证据，建立一个哮喘发病机制的整合模型，强调需要更早干预以改变哮喘的自然病程，并发现针对疾病未满足机制的新型干预手段
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，摘要未说明检索策略、纳入标准与偏倚评估，证据等级无法判断；关于生物制剂经杯状细胞增生、黏液栓塞、肥大细胞-气道平滑肌相互作用改善肺功能的机制为推测性表述，缺乏对应效应量；'更早干预以改变自然病程'这一结论在摘要中无直接临床证据支撑；IL-17/IL-23/中性粒细胞趋化因子'无临床获益且可能有害'未给出任何数值或研究来源；儿童与青少年中 IgE、IL-4Rα 优于 IL-5 的说法为跨试验间接比较，存在人群与设计异质性

papers.reason: 为哮喘生物制剂作用域差异（发作次数 vs 肺功能 vs 症状）提供机制解释框架，影响重症哮喘靶点选择与随访终点设定的临床思路
papers.abstract_en: Biologic therapies have transformed severe asthma management while providing insights into the mechanisms underlying clinical disease. Inhibition of IgE, interleukin (IL)-5/IL-5R, IL4Rα (IL-4/IL-13) and thymic stomal lymphopoietin (TSLP) have established the causal contribution of type 2 (T2) inflammation to exacerbations and systemic corticosteroid dependence. In children and young people, the evidence for exacerbation reduction is more robust for targeting IgE and IL4Rα than IL5 potentially reflecting a greater contribution of allergen and IgE mediated mechanisms in early onset disease. In general, T2-directed biological therapy has a larger positive impact on the frequency of asthma attacks than lung function and day-to-day symptoms although there is some inconsistencies in the magnitude of benefit observed in different domains. This may be because biologics targeting T2 inflammation beyond IL5 exert effects upon structural cells such as goblet cell hyperplasia, mucus plugging, and mast cell-airway smooth muscle interactions translating to greater downstream effects on lung function airway hyper-responsiveness. The impact of biologics upon co-morbidities such as nasal polyposis and eczema is also molecular pathway specific, which provides insights into shared mechanisms. Conversely, targeting neutrophil chemokines, IL-17 inhibition, and IL-23 provides no clinical benefit and may cause met harm, suggesting a role for these pathways in mitigating airway microbial dysbiosis and infection. This review synthesises mechanistic and clinical evidence from successful, unsuccessful and harmful biologic interventions to develop an integrated model of asthma pathogenesis that highlights the need for earlier intervention to alter asthma's natural history and the discovery of novel interventions targeting unmet mechanisms of disease.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The clinical benefits of current treatments for esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) are often limited, partly because of the immunosuppressive characteristics of the tumor microenvironment (TME). Natural products have attracted increasing attention in therapeutic research because of their potential immunomodulatory properties and favorable safety profiles. Thymoquinone (TQ), a bioactive quinone derived from the seeds of Nigella sativa, has shown antitumor activity in several solid tumors. However, its immunomodulatory effects in ESCC remain largely unexplored. METHODS: The in vivo antitumor effects of TQ and its impact on the TME were evaluated in ESCC-bearing mouse models. The contribution of macrophages to TQ-mediated tumor suppression was examined through clodronate liposome-mediated depletion. Tumor-associated macrophage (TAM) phenotypes were characterized by flow cytometry, proteomic profiling, and Seahorse analysis. Molecular docking and CETSA, together with functional assays, were used to investigate the molecular basis of TQ-mediated TAM reprogramming. The association between PLK1 expression and CD163+ TAM abundance was further assessed in ESCC specimens. RESULTS: TQ suppressed ESCC growth and modulated TAM phenotypes in vivo. In vitro, TQ reprogrammed macrophages toward an M1-like phenotype. Macrophage depletion attenuated the antitumor effect of TQ, indicating that macrophages contribute to TQ-mediated tumor suppression. This phenotypic shift was accompanied by a change in metabolic preference from OXPHOS to glycolysis. Mechanistically, TQ downregulated PLK1 and its downstream effector FOXM1, thereby shifting macrophage polarization from a suppressive state toward an immune-activating M1-like phenotype. Notably, PLK1 expression was positively associated with CD163+ TAM abundance in ESCC specimens, suggesting the potential clinical relevance of PLK1 in the ESCC TME. CONCLUSION: Overall, these findings suggest that TQ suppresses ESCC progression, at least in part, by modulating the PLK1-FOXM1 axis to reprogram TAMs toward an M1-like phenotype. These findings provide a rationale for further investigation of TQ as a potential immunomodulatory agent for ESCC.

papers.title_zh: 流感后30天内肺结核发病风险升高（IRR 6.68），但暴露前阴性对照窗同样显著升高（IRR 3.36）的自我对照病例系列研究
papers.title_en: Short-term risk of pulmonary tuberculosis after influenza in adults: a population-based self-controlled case series study.
papers.authors: Zhang X, Liu Y, Yan B, Qi X, Huang L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Beijing Chaoyang District Center for Disease Control and Prevention (Beijing Chaoyang District Institute of Health Inspe…
papers.results: 暴露前阴性对照窗IRR为3.36（95% CI: 1.92-5.88）；流感后第1-30天IRR最高为6.68（95% CI: 4.48-9.94）；第31-60天IRR降至3.61（95% CI: 2.10-6.19）；第61-90天IRR为1.05（95% CI: 0.39-2.82）恢复至基线；第1-30天效应在老年人中更强（IRR: 13.06），在细菌学阳性结核中更强（IRR: 9.98）；敏感性分析支持上述结果。摘要未报告P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: 流感感染与肺结核风险的短暂升高相关，集中在最初30天并迅速下降，至90天恢复基线，老年人中关联更强。流感可能作为肺结核进展或再激活的短期触发因素。流感后加强肺结核警惕性及流感疫苗接种可能带来公共卫生收益。
papers.ai_note: 暴露前阴性对照窗IRR高达3.36（95% CI: 1.92-5.88），显著偏离1，提示SCCS的关键假设（暴露外时间点风险均质）被违反，存在反向因果/原发症状偏倚（结核前驱症状被诊断为流感）或检测偏倚的可能，因此流感后IRR的实际效应量可能被高估；作者结论中未提及该阴性对照异常。老年人亚组IRR 13.06与细菌学阳性IRR 9.98均未给出95%CI或P值，且样本量与亚组构成未说明，稳定性存疑。摘要未报告任何P值，亦未说明流感与结核诊断的确认方式、免疫抑制等混杂因素的控制。属非肿瘤呼吸传染病范畴，与胸部肿瘤/胸外科核心业务关联有限。

pico.p: 北京市朝阳区2016-2025年监测数据中，年龄≥15岁、同时有流感感染记录与首次活动性肺结核事件者540例
pico.ic: 流感发病后预设风险窗（第1-30、31-60、61-90天）与基线期比较；暴露前第-30至-1天为阴性对照窗；条件Poisson回归，校正年龄与日历时间季节

papers.reason: 为流感后短期肺结核风险时间窗提供量化数据，可影响流感高发季结核筛查与随访强度的公共卫生决策；同时其升高的阴性对照窗是评价SCCS设计在传染病时序因果推断中方法学局限的典型反例，可为类似研究设计与审稿提供对照基线。
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Influenza infection may impair host immune control of Mycobacterium tuberculosis, but the short-term risk of active pulmonary tuberculosis (PTB) following influenza in adults remains unclear. We aimed to quantify this risk and identify the specific time window of elevated risk. METHODS: We conducted a population-based self-controlled case series study using surveillance data from Chaoyang District, Beijing, 2016-2025. Individuals aged ≥15 years with both influenza infection and a first episode of active PTB were included. Conditional Poisson regression was used to estimate incidence rate ratios (IRRs) for PTB during predefined post-influenza risk windows (days 1-30, 31-60, and 61-90 after influenza onset), and a pre-exposure negative-control window (days -30 to -1), compared with baseline periods, adjusting for age and calendar time season. RESULTS: A total of 540 individuals were included. The IRR for PTB during the pre-exposure window was 3.36 (95% CI: 1.92-5.88). The risk was highest in the first 30 days (IRR: 6.68, 95% CI: 4.48-9.94), rapidly declined to 3.61 (95% CI: 2.10-6.19), during days 31-60, and returned to baseline by days 61-90 (IRR: 1.05, 95% CI: 0.39-2.82). The association effect in the first 30 days was markedly stronger in older adults (IRR: 13.06) and those with bacteriologically positive tuberculosis (IRR: 9.98). Sensitivity analyses supported these findings. CONCLUSION: Influenza infection was associated with a transient increase in the risk of PTB, concentrated in the first 30 days and rapidly declining thereafter, returning to baseline by 90 days, with a stronger association among older adults. Influenza may act as a short-term trigger for PTB progression or reactivation. Enhanced PTB vigilance after influenza and influenza vaccination may offer public health benefits.

papers.title_en: Sputum eosinophils and high serum IgE are independently associated with overuse of rescue bronchodilators in asthmatics.
papers.authors: Louis F, Guissard F, Paulus V, Regnier F, Philippe G, Louis R, Schleich F
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Pharmacy, University of Liège, Liège, Belgium.
papers.results: 所有T2标志物间均显著相关（p<0.0001），血与痰嗜酸粒细胞相关最强（Rs=0,52），IgE与FeNO相关最弱（Rs=0,23）；单因素分析中所有T2标志物均与过度使用相关，经年龄、BMI、吸烟和FEV1%预计值校正后仍存在；但该关联仅在FeNO最高阈值（50 ppb）和IgE最高阈值（700 KU/L）成立，而痰嗜酸粒细胞（阈值1%至50%）和血嗜酸粒细胞（150至500/µl）在各阈值范围内均显著；纳入四种T2标志物的多因素logistic回归中，仅痰嗜酸粒细胞与高IgE水平维持与过度使用状态的关联（摘要未报告OR值、95%CI或P值）
papers.authors_conclusion: Sputum eosinophils and high serum IgE emerge as T2 biomarker independently associated with overuse of rescue bronchodilators in asthmatics.
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：摘要未给出各标志物的OR值、95%CI及P值，无法评估关联强度与统计精度；为横断面设计，只能得出相关性而无法推断因果方向（过度使用救急药物本身可能影响标志物检测时机）。过度使用定义为ACQ第6项≥3属自报行为，存在回忆偏倚。仅少数患者为SABA单药治疗，人群以ICS/LABA维持为主，外推至未控制治疗人群需谨慎。FeNO仅在最高阈值50 ppb、IgE仅在700 KU/L才显著，提示阈值选择可能影响结论稳定性，而痰/血嗜酸粒细胞的阈值范围较宽，四者可比性受限。信息不足：痰嗜酸粒细胞检测需诱导痰，实际完成比例未报告，可能存在选择偏倚。

pico.p: 2167例哮喘患者，其中73%接受ICS/LABA维持治疗，少数仅用SABA或SABA/SAMA
pico.ic: 暴露为四类T2生物标志物（痰嗜酸粒细胞、血嗜酸粒细胞、FeNO、总血清IgE）按临床阈值分层；对照为各标志物低水平组，组间比较救急支气管舒张剂过度使用（ACQ第6项≥3）发生率

papers.reason: 为哮喘患者救急支气管舒张剂过度使用的T2生物标志物关联提供大样本横断面证据，可作为哮喘门诊行为管理与生物标志物分层随访的参考基线；但因无效应量与因果推断能力，仅作探索性关联证据，不改变治疗决策
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Overuse of rescue bronchodilators in asthma is associated with increased morbidity and mortality. The relationship between T2 biomarkers and overuse of rescue bronchodilators has not been investigated so far. METHODS: Here we conducted a large retrospective cross-sectional study leveraging our asthma clinic data base to evaluate the relationship between the item 6 of the asthma control questionnaire (ACQ) and the levels of blood and sputum eosinophils, FeNO and total serum IgE in 2167 asthmatics the majority of whom (73%) were receiving maintenance with ICS/LABA leaving a minority of patients treated with SABA or SABA/SAMA only. Overuse of rescue was defined as a score ≥ 3 at the item 6 of ACQ. Analyses were performed by univariate and multivariate logistic regression after stratification of T2 biomarkers following clinically pertinent thresholds. RESULTS: There were significant correlations between all T2 biomarkers (p < 0.0001), the strongest correlation being observed between blood and sputum eosinophils (Rs = 0,52) and the weakest between IgE and FeNO (Rs = 0,23). After univariate analysis, all T2 biomarkers associated with overuse of rescue bronchodilators and this persisted after adjustment for age, BMI, smoking and FEV1% predicted. However, this only held true for the highest threshold for FeNO (50 ppb) and IgE (700 KU/L) while sputum eosinophils and blood eosinophils displayed a significant association over thresholds ranging from 1% to 50% and from 150 to 500/µl respectively. After multiple logistic regression analysis including the four T2 biomarkers, only sputum eosinophils and high IgE level maintained their association with the overuser status. CONCLUSIONS: Sputum eosinophils and high serum IgE emerge as T2 biomarker independently associated with overuse of rescue bronchodilators in asthmatics.

papers.results: Part 1：LRTI患者外周血中性粒细胞计数及CRP、IL-6水平升高；大容量BALF（60-120mL）检出显著差异参数多于小容量（9 vs 8；P<0.05）。Part 2：感染组血清IL-6高于定植组；BALF中感染组中性粒细胞及多形核细胞比例更高，而巨噬细胞、CD206+HLA-DR+巨噬细胞（组织驻留巨噬细胞）、单核细胞及组织驻留巨噬细胞/CD14low CD16+单核细胞比值（TRMMR）更低（P<0.05）。预测感染的AUC：CD16+CD24+中性粒细胞0.668、多形核细胞0.673、联合模型0.693；预测定植的AUC：巨噬细胞0.682、CD206+HLA-DR+巨噬细胞0.687、TRMMR 0.676、单核细胞0.681。摘要未报告AUC的95%CI或P值

papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVE: This study aims to ascertain the optimal volume and procedural protocol for bronchoscopic bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) in patients with lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI), improve diagnostic yield, and identify cell-component-based biomarkers in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) that can distinguish active infection from microbial colonization. METHODS: This study is comprised of two distinct phases. In Part 1, a cohort of 130 patients was enrolled, including 96 individuals with confirmed LRTI and 34 without LRTI. Under bronchoscopic guidance, two sequential 60 mL aliquots of normal saline (total volume, 120 mL) were instilled into the target segment. BALF was collected separately after each 60 mL instillation. The microbial yield and cellular composition of each aliquot were analyzed to ascertain the optimal volume and procedural protocol for BAL in patients with LRTI. In Part 2, of these 130 patients, 110 with suspected LRTI were further classified based on clinical and microbiological criteria: 96 were identified as having a pathogenic infection, while 14 were determined to have microbial colonization. BAL was performed using the optimal volume and method established in Part 1. The BALF obtained was analyzed to identify cellular biomarkers capable of distinguishing active infection from microbial colonization. The diagnostic efficacy of these biomarkers was assessed. RESULTS: In Part 1, patients with LRTI exhibited elevated peripheral blood neutrophil counts and higher CRP and IL-6 levels. Large-volume BALF (60-120mL) revealed a greater number of significantly different parameters (9 in Large-volume vs 8 in Small-volume;P<0.05). In Part 2, the pathogenic group had higher serum IL-6 levels than the colonized group. Analysis of BALF showed higher neutrophils and polymorphonuclear cells, whereas macrophages, CD206+HLA-DR+ macrophages (tissue-resident macrophages), mononuclear cells, and tissue-resident macrophages to CD14low CD16+ monocytes ratio (TRMMR) were lower (P<0.05). The AUCs for predicting infection were 0.668 for CD16+ CD24+ neutrophils, 0.673 for polymorphonuclear cells, and 0.693 for the combined model. The AUCs for predicting colonization were 0.682 for macrophages, 0.687 for CD206+HLA-DR+ macrophages, 0.676 for TRMMR, and 0.681 for mononuclear cells. CONCLUSION: Large-volume BALF is optimal for cellular analysis in LRTI. Elevated proportions of neutrophils and polymorphonuclear cells may indicate infection, whereas increased proportions of macrophages (particularly CD206+HLA-DR+subset), mononuclear cells, and TRMMR were associated with colonization. These cellular indices may serve as valuable biomarkers for differentiating infection from colonization.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: A clinical diagnosis of pneumonia encompasses infections with fundamentally different microbial ecologies. We asked whether pathogen community analysis of tNGS data from bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) could reveal ecological heterogeneity masked by the binary pneumonia label. METHODS: We analyzed 1,247 BALF tNGS samples (December 2025-July 2026). Read counts were RPM-normalized and residualized against library size. Community differences were assessed by PERMANOVA (Bray-Curtis) with PERMDISP validation. Principal component analysis (PCA) identified ecological axes; an a-priori dysbiosis index (literature-defined nosocomial minus oral pathogens) provided convergent validation. Indicator species analysis (IndVal) identified pathogens driving community differences. A dual-axis quadrant framework (PC1 × PC2) was defined for clinical translation. RESULTS: Pneumonia status alone explained a statistically significant but ecologically negligible fraction of community variance (PERMANOVA on Bray-Curtis distances: pseudo-F=2.77, R2 = 0.23%, p=0.001). PCA identified two orthogonal, library-size-independent axes: PC1 (5.4%, oral enrichment) and PC2 (4.1%, nosocomial burden). PC2 correlated with respiratory failure (r=0.19, p<0.001), sepsis (r=0.18, p<0.001), and stroke (r=0.21, p<0.001). The a-priori dysbiosis index converged with the gradient (pneumonia Q1→Q5: 37%→50%, respiratory failure 6%→21%). Four ecological quadrants defined by axis position captured graded severity: the two nosocomial-high quadrants (Type III and IV, 20% each) showed higher respiratory failure (17.2% and 14.2%) and sepsis (9.2% and 7.1%) than the nosocomial-low quadrants (Type I, 29%: 7.8% and 2.5%; Type II, 31%: 10.4% and 4.1%). Temporal validation (early vs late cohort) and sensitivity analyses confirmed gradient stability. CONCLUSIONS: The pneumonia label aggregates ecologically distinct communities. Pathogen community analysis extracts clinical information from tNGS data that binary diagnosis misses. A dual-axis ecological framework supplements the pneumonia label by positioning each sample along an oral-to-nosocomial gradient that tracks with clinical severity.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome (BHD) is a rare genetic disorder caused by mutations in the folliculin (FLCN) gene, characterised by cutaneous fibrofolliculomas, renal tumours and pulmonary cysts. These cysts increase the risk of spontaneous pneumothorax (PTX) and may impact lung function. However, the long-term pulmonary impact of BHD remains poorly understood. This cohort study aimed to evaluate pulmonary function in BHD patients over 4 years. METHOD: A descriptive double-centre cohort study was carried out from retrospective data conducted across three Danish regions, assessing clinical and thoracic imaging characteristics and pulmonary function test (PFT) parameters in patients with BHD. RESULTS: Data from 373 BHD patients were analysed. The mean age at diagnosis was 47.3±15.9 years, and 52.8% were women. Pulmonary cysts were present in 85% of patients, and 37.5% had at least one PTX (median of two per patient). Baseline PFT parameters, including forced expiratory volume in 1 s (FEV1), forced vital capacity (FVC), FEV1/FVC ratio, total lung capacity, residual volume and diffusing capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (D LCO), were within or above normal ranges. A subgroup of 140 patients contributed longitudinal follow-up data during the 4-year observation period. After adjusting for age, sex, smoking, pleurodesis and baseline values, statistically significant, minor physiological declines in FEV1, FVC and D LCO were observed. CONCLUSION: Although BHD patients had normal baseline lung function, small but statistically significant declines in FEV1, FVC and D LCO occurred over 4 years. However, the clinical relevance of these changes appeared limited, as all mean values remained within normal ranges.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Urban particulate matter (PM) is a major pollutant driving obstructive airways disease. We hypothesised that this reflects activation of the Calcium-Sensing Receptor (CaSR) on airways cells by metal cations in PM. METHODS: We examined (i) the metal cation content of PM; (ii) the temporal relationship between PM exposure and asthma exacerbation in human populations, assessed using a retrospective, observational, population-based cohort study; (iii) CaSR activation by PM in transfected HEK293 cells; (iv) human lung CaSR immunoreactivity; (v) PM induction of pro-inflammatory mediators in primary human airways cells and dendritic cell maturation; (vi) the therapeutic efficacy of a topically applied CaSR negative allosteric modulator (NAM) in a murine surrogate of obstructive airways disease. FINDINGS: PM contained multiple cationic CaSR activators. In human populations, asthma exacerbation correlated with exposure to calcium ions within ambient PM. PM activated the CaSR in HEK293 cells. Airways epithelial and innate pro-inflammatory cells intensely expressed the CaSR. PM exposure elevated expression of mRNA encoding alarmins and pro-inflammatory mediators by bronchial epithelial cells and dendritic cell maturation, effects all significantly abrogated by NAMs. In the murine surrogate, a topically applied CaSR NAM significantly abrogated IL-33-driven lung inflammation and remodelling in vivo. INTERPRETATION: PM-induced airways inflammation is at least partly driven by CaSR activation. Prophylactic, topical therapy with CaSR NAMs may arrest progression of airways obstruction in severe asthma and COPD. papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Lung cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death worldwide, and non-small cell lung cancer accounts for approximately 85% of all cases. Although immune checkpoint inhibitors have transformed the therapeutic landscape, downregulation of the major histocompatibility complex and chronic immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment frequently limit the efficacy of conventional T cell immunotherapy. Gamma delta T cells, unconventional lymphocytes enriched in pulmonary mucosa, provide surveillance independent of the major histocompatibility complex; however, their functional plasticity creates a paradoxical double-edged sword in non-small cell lung cancer. MAIN BODY: Cytotoxic type 1 gamma delta T cells eradicate tumors through perforin and granzyme release and interferon-gamma secretion, whereas commensal microbiota-driven interleukin-1 beta and interleukin-23 can subvert tissue-resident subsets into pro-tumorigenic type 17 cells that accelerate cancer progression via interleukin-17-mediated neutrophil recruitment. This review integrates mechanistic insights into this dichotomy, emphasizing the butyrophilin 3A1/2A1 phosphoantigen recognition axis, metabolic reprogramming under nutrient deprivation, and microbiota-immune crosstalk. We further examine how the hostile lung microenvironment imposes metabolic, epigenetic, and physical barriers that impair gamma delta T cell efficacy, and survey emerging engineering strategies including allogeneic cellular products, epigenetic priming, and combination approaches. CONCLUSION: We propose a translational roadmap integrating allogeneic off-the-shelf cellular engineering, metabolic priming to reverse immune senescence, and microbiota-directed polarization to stabilize durable anti-tumor phenotypes. These strategies aim to overcome immune escape caused by impaired antigen presentation and advance precision immunotherapy for non-small cell lung cancer.

papers.title_zh: CD26/DPP4抑制（维格列汀）未能阻止实验性慢性肺移植排斥，仅减轻细支气管周围纤维化
papers.title_en: Pharmacological Inhibition of CD26/DPP4 Attenuates Peribronchiolar Fibrosis in Experimental Chronic Lung Allograft Rejection.
papers.authors: Ohm B, Haberecker M, Mertens K, De Meester I, Zissel G, Diederichs S, Jungraithmayr W
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Thoracic Surgery, Faculty of Medicine, Medical Center, University of Freiburg, University of Freiburg, Fre…
papers.results: 维格列汀使血清DPP4活性系统性降低（p=0.0111）；细支气管周围纤维化显著减轻（p=0.0381），而实质及胸膜纤维化无差异；移植物内Dpp4 mRNA显著降低（p=0.0281）；Col1a1、Fn1、Acta2、Il1b、Tgfb1等细胞外基质、细胞表型及促纤维化细胞因子标志物均无差异，仅Col1a1呈非显著下降趋势；细支气管周围CD26蛋白与实质α-SMA无差异；两组移植物大体观均实变、含气极少；每组n=10
papers.authors_conclusion: CD26/DPP4抑制未能阻止慢性排斥，但产生了细支气管周围纤维化的区室特异性减轻。这确定了CD26/DPP4作为一个候选抗纤维化靶点，值得在优化药物递送和明确细胞区室特征的基础上进一步研究。
papers.ai_note: 主要研究假设（减轻纤维化重构/阻止慢性排斥）总体未达成，结论却突出区室特异性的细支气管周围纤维化这一单项组织学指标的P=0.0381，属选择性强调；细支气管周围纤维化是否为预设主要终点摘要未说明（信息不足）；n=10/组且在多个区室与多个标志物间比较，未提及多重比较校正；无肺功能、存活或CLAD表型等功能学终点，两组移植物均实变提示模型本身纤维化动态范围有限；作者结论仍定位为候选靶点，转化价值尚待验证。

pico.p: C57BL/6J小鼠接受BALB/c供体同种异体原位左肺移植并给予标准免疫抑制，维格列汀组与对照组各10只
pico.ic: 维格列汀（CD26/DPP4抑制） vs 对照

papers.reason: 为慢性肺移植排斥（CLAD）抗纤维化靶点的临床前候选药物提供初步但有限的证据，影响是否推进CD26/DPP4抑制剂转化研究的决策；同时提示肺移植慢性排斥动物模型的终点选择与功效限制，可供后续研究设计参考。
papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: Chronic lung allograft dysfunction (CLAD) remains the main barrier to long-term survival after lung transplantation, and effective preventive strategies are lacking. CD26/DPP4 is implicated in ischaemia-reperfusion injury and acute rejection and is expressed in fibrotic areas of chronically rejected allografts. We investigated whether pharmacological CD26/DPP4 inhibition with vildagliptin attenuates fibrotic remodelling in experimental chronic lung allograft rejection. METHODS: C57BL/6J mice underwent allogeneic orthotopic left-lung transplantation from BALB/c donors under standard immunosuppression and were assigned to vildagliptin treatment or control (n = 10 per group). Grafts were analysed four weeks after transplantation by compartment-specific quantitative histology, RT-qPCR of fibrotic and profibrotic markers, and immunohistochemistry for CD26 and α-SMA. Systemic target engagement was confirmed by serum DPP4 activity assays. RESULTS: Vildagliptin achieved a systemically measurable reduction in serum DPP4 activity (p = 0.0111). Peribronchiolar fibrosis was significantly attenuated in treated animals (p = 0.0381), whereas no differences were detected in parenchymal and pleural fibrosis. Intragraft Dpp4 mRNA was significantly reduced (p = 0.0281), while no differences in extracellular matrix, cell phenotype and profibrotic cytokine markers (Col1a1, Fn1, Acta2, Il1b, Tgfb1) were detected, with only a non-significant trend for reduction in Col1a1. Peribronchiolar CD26 protein and parenchymal α-SMA did not differ. In both groups, grafts macroscopically appeared consolidated and minimally aerated. CONCLUSION: CD26/DPP4 inhibition did not prevent chronic rejection but produced a compartment-specific reduction in peribronchiolar fibrosis. This identifies CD26/DPP4 as a candidate antifibrotic target warranting further study with optimised drug delivery and characterisation of the cellular compartment.

papers.title_zh: 支气管肺泡灌洗液mNGS在疑似肺部感染的结缔组织病患者中提高病原检出率，但与常规检测一致性有限、未证实对结局的影响
papers.title_en: Diagnostic value of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid metagenomic next-generation sequencing in connective tissue diseases patients with suspected pulmonary infection.
papers.authors: Cui Y, Ma D, Hou R, Liu Y, Liu Y, Xu K, Zhang L
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, Shanxi Bethune Hospitals, Shanxi Academy of Medical Sciences, Tongji Shanxi H…
papers.results: 总体病原检出率mNGS高于CMTs（77.7% vs. 45.7%，P<0.05）；mNGS检出35种病原（细菌18种、真菌7种、病毒10种），对应检出率分别为55.6%、50.6%、59.3%；以CMTs为微生物学对照，总体一致性有限（kappa=0.368），阳性符合率（PPA）93.3%，阴性符合率（NPA）41.7%。MDT评估后66例（81.5%）归类为肺部感染，39例（48.1%）为间质性肺疾病，11例（13.6%）需无创或有创机械通气，30天死亡率13.6%；混合感染较单感染更常见，细菌-真菌-病毒合并感染最常见，病毒最常为合并病原
papers.authors_conclusion: mNGS提高了CTD疑似肺部感染患者的下呼吸道病原检出率，可能为区分肺部感染与CTD相关肺部受累及个体化临床决策提供补充信息；其对长期临床结局的影响需要前瞻性、多中心对照研究证实
papers.ai_note: 方法学局限：无独立金标准，MDT分类本身包含临床判断与检测结果，存在参考标准偏倚；以CMTs为对照而非真值，kappa仅0.368、NPA低至41.7%，mNGS阳性中相当部分无法被CMTs证实，难以区分真阳性与定植/污染；单中心回顾性设计，未报告mNGS指导治疗调整的具体比例与对结局（机械通气、30天死亡率）的实际影响，'associated with adjustments'为无对照的描述性陈述；检出率差异未按病原类别或感染/非感染亚组分层报告

pico.p: 山西白求恩医院风湿免疫科2020年5月至2025年6月住院的结缔组织病（CTD）且HRCT示新发或进展性肺部病变、临床疑似肺部感染患者81例（中位年龄57岁，62.9%女性，常见类型为IIM、RA、SLE）
pico.ic: 干预：支气管肺泡灌洗液mNGS；对照：常规微生物学检测（CMTs），两者均在入院72小时内完成；最终诊断由多学科团队（MDT）评估确立

papers.reason: 为风湿免疫科CTD患者肺部病变鉴别（感染 vs. CTD相关肺受累）这一临床难点提供mNGS诊断效能的本底数据，可作为未来诊断性研究的检出率与一致性参照基线；同时提示该场景下mNGS阴性结果排除感染的能力有限
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) is a broad-range pathogen detection technique that provides a culture-independent approach to the etiological diagnosis of infectious diseases. However, its value for lower respiratory tract pathogen detection and clinical management in patients with connective tissue diseases (CTD) remains to be further clarified. METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled 81 hospitalized patients with CTD at the Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, Shanxi Bethune Hospital, between May 2020 and June 2025.All patients had new or progressive pulmonary lesions on high-resolution computed tomography (HRCT), were clinically suspected of having pulmonary infection, and underwent bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) mNGS and conventional microbiological tests (CMTs) within 72 hours of admission. Final clinical classification was established by multidisciplinary team (MDT) assessment. Pathogen detection and agreement between mNGS and CMTs were compared. RESULTS: The median age was 57 years, and 62.9% of patients were female. The most common CTD types were IIM, RA, and SLE. Following MDT assessment, 66 patients (81.5%) were classified as having pulmonary infections, 39 (48.1%) had interstitial lung disease (ILD), 11(13.6%) required noninvasive or invasive mechanical ventilation, and the 30-day mortality rate was 13.6%. The overall pathogen detection rate was higher with mNGS than with CMTs (77.7% vs. 45.7%, P<0.05).mNGS detected 35 pathogen species, including 18 bacterial, 7 fungal, and 10 viral species, the corresponding detection rates were 55.6%, 50.6%, and 59.3%, respectively. Mixed infections were more common than single infections, with bacterial-fungal-viral coinfection being the most frequent pathogen and viruses being the most common copathogens. Using CMTs as the microbiological comparator, overall agreement was limited (kappa=0.368), with a positive percent agreement (PPA) of 93.3% and a negative percent agreement (NPA) of 41.7%. mNGS results were incorporated into subsequent comprehensive clinical decision-making and were associated with adjustments in anti-infective and immunosuppressive treatment strategies. CONCLUSION: mNGS increased lower respiratory tract pathogens detection in CTD patients with suspected pulmonary infection, and may provide complementary information for distinguishing pulmonary infection from CTD-related pulmonary involvement and for individualized clinical decision-making. Its impact on long-term clinical outcomes requires confirmation in prospective, multicenter controlled studies.

papers.title_zh: COVID-19相关急性呼吸衰竭无创通气患者中生物电阻抗相角与NIV失败及住院死亡的关联（NIVAR单中心前瞻性队列，n=74）
papers.title_en: Evaluation of Bioelectric Impedance analysis in a cohort of non-invasive Ventilated patients with Acute Respiratory failure: The NIVAR Study.
papers.authors: Fuset-Cabanes MP, Pérez-Fernández XL, Via-Clavero G, Gordillo-Benítez MA, di Paolo F, Huguet-Briva M, Sánchez-Clavero C, Dominguez-Alatorre D et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Hospital Universitari de Bellvitge, Intensive Care Department, C/Feixa Llarga s/n, 08907, L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Bar…
papers.results: 共纳入74例患者，58例（78.4%）为男性，中位年龄63.5（53-71）岁，平均BMI 30±6 kg·m-2；43例（58.1%）在启动NIV后需气管插管，NIV开始至插管的中位时间为4（3-6）天。经潜在协变量校正后，较高PhA与NIV失败率较低的趋势相关（HR: 0.54; 95% CI: 0.29-1.00; P=0.05）；较高PhA与较低住院死亡相关（HR: 0.43; 95% CI: 0.24-0.76; P=0.004）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 生物电阻抗参数测量的身体成分可能与较低的死亡率以及NIV失败降低的趋势相关。
papers.ai_note: PhA与NIV失败的关联为边界性结果（95%CI上限恰为1.00、P=0.05），作者以'趋势'表述，而死亡分析P=0.004更显著并被结论前置强调；PhA的HR计量单位（每度/每SD）未说明，信息不足；死亡事件数未报告，信息不足；'经潜在协变量校正'但协变量清单与筛选方法未说明，信息不足；单中心、n=74、仅COVID-19人群，外推至其他病因AHRF受限；BIA在NIV后24小时内测量易受复苏液体潴留/容量状态影响，可能混淆PhA与结局的关联；无外部验证。

pico.p: 需NIV支持并入住ICU的COVID-19相关急性呼吸衰竭患者74例（男性58例[78.4%]，中位年龄63.5[53-71]岁，平均BMI 30±6 kg·m-2）
pico.ic: NIV开始后24小时内行生物电阻抗（BIA）评估并记录相角（PhA）等参数；观察性研究，无干预对照

papers.reason: 为危重症急性呼吸衰竭患者以相角评估肌肉/营养状态、辅助NIV失败风险分层提供假设生成性证据，并为类似队列设计提供事件率（58.1%需插管）与效应量参考基线；证据强度不足以改变NIV失败预测或营养干预决策
papers.abstract_en: OBJECTIVES: Bioimpedance (BIA) parameters, such as phase angle (PhA), could assess body composition and tissue integrity (e.g., muscle mass status) in critically ill. Respiratory muscular dysfunction may lead to failure of non-invasive ventilation (NIV), defined as the need for endotracheal intubation (ETI). Thus, we aimed to evaluate the association of BIA parameters with NIV failure and hospital mortality. DESIGN: Single centre prospective observational cohort study. Registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06996197). PATIENTS: Patients with AHRF with COVID-19 who required NIV support and ICU admission. INTERVENTIONS: A BIA assessment was performed within the first 24 hours after NIV onset. MEASUREMENTS AND MAIN RESULTS: Patient characteristics, severity scores, NIV settings, BIA parameters and outcomes were recorded. Cox-hazard multivariate analysis was used to assess the association between BIA parameters and NIV failure. Seventy-four patients were included, 58 (78.4%) men, with a median age of 63.5 (53-71) years. The mean BMI was 30±6 kg·m-2. Forty-three patients (58.1%) required ETI after initiating NIV support, with a median length of 4 (3-6) days from the NIV onset to ETI. After adjusting for potential covariates, higher PhA was associated with a trend towards lower rates of NIV failure (HR: 0.54; 95% CI: 0.29-1.00; P=0.05) and lower hospital mortality (Hazard Ratio: 0.43; 95% CI: 0.24-0.76; P=0.004). CONCLUSIONS: We found that body composition measured by BIA parameters may be associated with lower mortality and a trend towards lower NIV failure.

papers.title_zh: 美泊利珠单抗在中剂量或高剂量吸入激素基线的重症哮喘患者中均减少急性发作并降低口服激素剂量（REALITI-A事后分析）
papers.title_en: Mepolizumab benefits severe asthma regardless of medium- or high-dose inhaled corticosteroids at baseline.
papers.authors: Caruso C, Smith A, Patel M, Canonica GW, Alfonso-Cristancho R, Zhang L, Howarth P, Pilette C et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore, Rome, Italy.
papers.results: 与美泊利珠单抗治疗前相比，治疗后临床显著急性发作率在中剂量与高剂量ICS亚组分别降低80%和73%；基线使用维持口服激素（mOCS）的患者中，mOCS中位剂量在中剂量与高剂量亚组分别降低85%和100%，分别有45%和58%的患者停用mOCS；中剂量与高剂量ICS亚组ACQ-5评分较基线改善1.57分和1.55分。摘要未报告任何95%CI或P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: 接受美泊利珠单抗治疗后，重症哮喘患者无论基线mICS剂量如何，临床显著急性发作和mOCS剂量均减少，症状控制改善。
papers.ai_note: 信息不足：为无对照的治疗前后自身比较，观察到的改善可能受回归均值、疾病自然波动及合并用药调整影响，无法归因于药物；标题与结论强调"无论基线剂量均获益"，但摘要未给出两亚组间比较的交互作用检验或组间统计量，也未报告任何CI/P，亚组间数值差异（80% vs 73%、85% vs 100%）是否具统计学意义无法判断；亚组为事后(post hoc)分析，属探索性。

pico.p: 接受新处方美泊利珠单抗100 mg皮下注射的成人重症哮喘患者，共822例，其中774例有基线中剂量ICS数据（按基线ICS剂量分为中剂量与高剂量亚组）
pico.ic: 美泊利珠单抗治疗前（12个月）vs治疗后（24个月）自身比较；按基线中剂量ICS与高剂量ICS亚组分层，无非治疗对照组

papers.reason: 影响重症哮喘患者在升级至高剂量ICS后启动生物制剂的时机判断与mOCS减停随访预期，但属呼吸非肿瘤领域且为无对照事后分析，与胸部肿瘤核心业务关联有限。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Severe asthma treatment commonly entails progression from medium- to high-dose maintenance inhaled corticosteroids (mICS) before biological therapies are considered. The objective of this post hoc analysis of REALITI-A was to assess the impact of mepolizumab on clinical outcomes when initiated in patients with severe asthma receiving either medium- or high-dose mICS at baseline. METHODS: REALITI-A (GSK ID: 204710) was a 2-year, prospective observational cohort study enrolling adult patients with asthma receiving newly prescribed mepolizumab 100 mg subcutaneously (index). Data were collected for 12 months before and 24 months after mepolizumab initiation. Outcomes included rate of clinically significant exacerbations requiring systemic corticosteroids and/or emergency department visit or hospitalisation pre- and post-mepolizumab, change from baseline (28 days before index) in daily maintenance oral corticosteroid (mOCS) dose to week 101-104, and change from baseline (90 days before index) in Asthma Control Questionnaire-5 score at month 24. RESULTS: Baseline mICS dose data were available for 774 out of 822 patients. Compared with pre-mepolizumab, the rate of clinically significant exacerbations post-mepolizumab reduced by 80% and 73% in the medium- and high-dose mICS subgroups, respectively. For patients with baseline mOCS use, median mOCS dose also reduced by 85% and 100% for the medium- and high-dose mICS subgroups, respectively, with 45% and 58% of patients discontinuing mOCS. For the medium- and high-dose mICS subgroups, least squares mean Asthma Control Questionnaire-5 score improved from pre-mepolizumab by 1.57 and 1.55 points. CONCLUSIONS: Following mepolizumab treatment, patients with severe asthma had reduced clinically significant exacerbations and mOCS dose and improved symptom control, regardless of baseline mICS dose.

papers.title_zh: 美泊利珠单抗治疗重度嗜酸性粒细胞性哮喘达到临床缓解者相关医疗费用更低：成本比较分析
papers.title_en: Cost savings associated with remission with mepolizumab in severe asthma: a cost comparison analysis.
papers.authors: Harvey ES, McLoughlin RF, Reeves P, Dolja-Gore X, Thomas D, McDonald VM, Fricker M, Hamada Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: School of Medicine and Public Health, College of Health, Medicine and Wellbeing, The University of Newcastle, New Lambto…
papers.results: 临床缓解率：Analysis 1 为28%，Analysis 2 为33%。Analysis 1（前瞻）：缓解组第二年年均费用较未缓解组低45%，缓解组每例平均费用 AUD 1318.19（95% CI 972.45-1663.93）vs 未缓解组 AUD 2405.63（95% CI 1712.56-3098.70）。Analysis 2：缓解组平均费用低52%，缓解组 AUD 1231.22（95% CI 996.29-1466.15）vs 未缓解组 AUD 2540.88（95% CI 1773.44-3308.33）。两项分析中，因急性发作住院及急诊就诊费用、哮喘相关门诊费用和药物费用在缓解组均更低。
papers.authors_conclusion: Achieving clinical remission with mepolizumab in SEA is associated with additional cost savings from the healthcare payer's perspective, further highlighting the importance of timeliness and appropriateness of biologic treatments in severe asthma.
papers.ai_note: 缓解为观察性分组而非随机分配，缓解者基线病情可能更轻，费用差异存在混杂，摘要未报告基线校正或多因素调整，也未报告组间比较的P值；仅计算第二年费用，未纳入美泊利珠单抗药费本身及首年费用，无法回答成本-效果问题；两项分析方向相反的时序设计（前瞻/回顾）本质为同一注册库数据的重复观察，非独立验证；结论由相关性上升为强调生物制剂及时应用的政策含义，存在推断外推。

pico.p: 澳大利亚美泊利珠单抗注册库中接受美泊利珠单抗治疗的重度嗜酸性粒细胞性哮喘患者，Analysis 1 n=223，Analysis 2 n=222
pico.ic: 按12个月/24个月是否达到临床缓解分组比较第二年哮喘相关医疗资源使用与非生物制剂药物费用（缓解 vs 未缓解，非干预性分组）

papers.reason: 为重度嗜酸性粒细胞性哮喘达到临床缓解的卫生经济学价值提供量化参照，可支撑生物制剂及时启动的经济学论证；同时其观察性设计为评估缓解-费用关联的混杂风险提供方法学案例。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The economic benefits of achieving remission in severe eosinophilic asthma (SEA) are unknown. METHODS: Asthma-related healthcare resource and non-biologic medication use costs during the second year of mepolizumab treatment were calculated for patients in the Australian Mepolizumab Registry. In cost comparison Analysis 1 (n=223), remission at 12 months was assessed with prospective evaluation of costs over the subsequent 12 months. Analysis 2 (n=222) evaluated remission at 24 months with retrospective evaluation of costs over the prior 12 months. Clinical remission was defined as: zero exacerbations (requiring hospitalisation, an emergency department (ED) visit or oral corticosteroid (OCS) use) and zero OCS use during the previous 6 months; and Asthma Control Questionnaire-5 ≤1. RESULTS: Clinical remission was achieved in 28% (Analysis 1) and 33% (Analysis 2) of patients receiving mepolizumab. Analysis 1 (prospective): annual mean costs during the second year of mepolizumab treatment were 45% lower in patients who had achieved remission (mean costs per patient for remission AUD 1318.19 (95% CI 972.45-1663.93) versus non-remission AUD 2405.63 (95% CI 1712.56-3098.70)). Analysis 2: mean costs were 52% lower in the remission group (mean costs for remission AUD 1231.22 (95% CI 996.29-1466.15) versus non-remission AUD 2540.88 (95% CI 1773.44-3308.33)). Across analyses, costs associated with hospitalisations and ED visits for exacerbations, asthma-related outpatient visits and medication use were lower in patients who achieved remission. CONCLUSION: Achieving clinical remission with mepolizumab in SEA is associated with additional cost savings from the healthcare payer's perspective, further highlighting the importance of timeliness and appropriateness of biologic treatments in severe asthma.

papers.title_zh: MPS合并矮小症与纵隔肿物致重度气管狭窄患者行支气管镜再通的麻醉管理：单例报告中SHFJV成功救援NFJV期间去饱和
papers.title_en: Anesthetic management for bronchoscopic intervention in a patient with mucopolysaccharidosis and short stature complicated by mediastinal mass-induced airway stenosis: a case report.
papers.authors: Chen X, Yao Y, Cai Y, Zhou Y, Cheng Q, Yang M
papers.affiliation_highlight: Center of Anesthesiology and Pain, Emergency General Hospital, Beijing, China.
papers.results: NFJV期间出现去饱和，启动SHFJV后缓解；因与气道不匹配取出14 mm覆膜气管支架；球囊扩张后残余狭窄降至约70%；患者于术后第3天出院，症状改善
papers.authors_conclusion: In this patient with MPS and critical tracheal stenosis, an LMA-based shared-airway technique with immediate access to SHFJV was used successfully during bronchoscopic recanalization.
papers.ai_note: 单例、无对照、样本量为1，仅报告至出院，无长期随访或并发症系统报告；去饱和的判定标准、持续时间与恢复指标均未量化；'球囊扩张后残余狭窄降至约70%'表述歧义（指残余狭窄程度还是改善幅度不明），信息不足；选择性呈现成功结局，未涉及该策略的失败风险与替代方案比较

pico.p: 1例33岁黏多糖贮积症（MPS）女性患者，身高100 cm、体重21.5 kg，进行性呼吸困难，前纵隔肿物50×22 mm，重度气管狭窄（最小子径约13×1 mm）
pico.ic: 全麻下以喉罩（LMA）为基础的共享气道技术联合喷射通气行支气管镜下气道再通（先常规频率喷射通气NFJV，去饱和后叠加高频喷射通气SHFJV）；无对照

papers.reason: 为MPS等困难气道合并纵隔肿物致重度狭窄患者的支气管镜干预麻醉策略提供可参考的操作路径（LMA共享气道+SHFJV即刻救援），影响此类高危病例的围术期通气预案设计；因系单例，仅可作情景化参考而非方案依据
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Mucopolysaccharidosis (MPS) is a group of inherited lysosomal storage disorders associated with difficult airway management. Critical tracheal compression from an anterior mediastinal mass presents an additional challenge during interventional bronchoscopy, when the airway is shared by the ventilation and procedural devices. CASE PRESENTATION: A 33-year-old woman with MPS (height, 100 cm; weight, 21.5 kg) and progressive dyspnea had a 50 × 22 mm anterior mediastinal mass and severe tracheal stenosis, with minimum luminal dimensions of approximately 13 × 1 mm. Bronchoscopic intervention was performed under general anesthesia using a laryngeal mask airway (LMA) and jet ventilation. Desaturation during normal-frequency jet ventilation (NFJV) resolved after superimposed high-frequency jet ventilation (SHFJV) was initiated. A 14-mm covered tracheal stent was removed because it was disproportionate to the patient's airway, and balloon dilatation reduced the residual stenosis to approximately 70%. The patient was discharged on postoperative day 3 with symptomatic improvement. CONCLUSION: In this patient with MPS and critical tracheal stenosis, an LMA-based shared-airway technique with immediate access to SHFJV was used successfully during bronchoscopic recanalization.

papers.study_type: 叙述性综述 · 提出概念性T0–T6轨迹框架，非验证性分期系统
papers.title_zh: 提出抗MDA5阳性快速进展性间质肺病治疗无反应识别的T0–T6轨迹并行决策框架（叙述性综述，未经验证）
papers.title_en: Recognizing treatment non-response in anti-MDA5-positive rapidly progressive interstitial lung disease: a trajectory-based framework for parallel escalation.
papers.authors: Zhang Q, Zhang H, Ma D, Li X, Zhang Y, Cai H, Li Y
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Surgery, The First Hospital of Jilin University, Changchun, China.
papers.authors_conclusion: It is intended as a structured communication and research model, not as a validated staging system or prescriptive clinical guideline. Its principal contribution is to define the questions that should be revisited when continued observation may threaten otherwise feasible treatment options.
papers.ai_note: 叙述性综述，无原始数据与验证，作者自述框架非经验证的分期系统或处方性指南，故不能直接指导个体患者治疗决策；框架条目（T0–T6）的来源为既有文献归纳，未报告检索策略、纳排标准与证据分级，存在选择性引用风险；概念区分（non-response/failure/refractory）为术语学贡献，无可操作阈值定义，信息不足：摘要未给出任何氧合、影像或炎症指标的量化判据
papers.reason: 为抗MDA5阳性RP-ILD治疗无反应的研究终点定义与队列设计提供术语框架和随访维度参照，但因未经验证不影响临床方案选择
papers.abstract_en: Anti-melanoma differentiation-associated gene 5 antibody-positive dermatomyositis complicated by rapidly progressive interstitial lung disease (anti-MDA5-positive RP-ILD) can progress from inflammatory lung injury to refractory respiratory failure within a short and clinically uncertain interval. Existing literature has largely evaluated individual immunomodulatory regimens, prognostic factors or organ-replacement outcomes, but provides limited guidance on when an inadequate early response should be regarded as clinically actionable treatment failure. This gap is important because persistent disease activity may coexist with infection, drug toxicity, pulmonary vascular events, air-leak syndromes and ventilation-related injury, each of which changes the expected benefit and risk of further immunosuppression. In this narrative review, we distinguish treatment non-response, treatment failure and refractory disease as related but non-equivalent concepts. We then organize evidence on treatment exposure, oxygenation and imaging trajectories, inflammatory activity, competing causes of deterioration, respiratory-support requirements and future treatment eligibility into a T0-T6 trajectory-based framework. The framework treats rescue immunomodulation, diagnostic reassessment, critical-care activation and preservation of advanced-support options as parallel decisions rather than consecutive treatment steps. It is intended as a structured communication and research model, not as a validated staging system or prescriptive clinical guideline. Its principal contribution is to define the questions that should be revisited when continued observation may threaten otherwise feasible treatment options.

papers.authors: Schleich F, Djukanovic R, Heaney LG, Noorduyn SG, Tacon C, Jiang X, Cooper L, Alfonso-Cristancho R et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: GIGA Research Group, Exercise Physiology Laboratory, Department of Physical Activity and Rehabilitation Sciences, Univer…

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Observational studies demonstrate that approximately one third of patients receiving mepolizumab for severe asthma achieve clinical remission (no exacerbations, no oral corticosteroid [OCS] use, controlled symptoms and stabilised lung function) after 1 year of treatment. Data suggest that patients initiating treatment before irreversible airway deterioration are more likely to achieve clinical remission. The prospective REIMAGINE study will evaluate clinical remission with mepolizumab in patients with severe asthma not receiving maintenance OCS (mOCS), without severe lung function impairment, in a real-world setting. METHODS: REIMAGINE is an international, multicentre, prospective, single-arm study of patients initiating mepolizumab who have forced expiratory volume in 1 s (FEV1) ≥ 60% predicted, ≤ 4 asthma exacerbations per year and are not receiving mOCS. The following data are being collected at baseline and at routine healthcare visits for 24 months: exacerbations; outpatient visits, emergency department visits and hospital admissions for asthma; medication use; lung function by spirometry; patient-reported outcomes, including the Asthma Control Test (ACT); and adverse events. The primary endpoint is clinical remission at 12 months using a four-component definition: no clinically significant asthma exacerbations (CSEs), no use of systemic corticosteroids for asthma, an ACT score of ≥ 20 and no clinically significant deterioration from baseline in FEV1. EXPECTED OUTCOMES: Predictors of achieving clinical remission in patients on biologic therapy include earlier treatment initiation, limited OCS use and lower lung function impairment. Initiation of biologic therapy with mepolizumab in participants of the REIMAGINE study, before disease progression, is predicted to reduce CSEs and the need for OCS, improve symptoms and maintain lung function, increasing the likelihood of achieving clinical remission. CONCLUSIONS: REIMAGINE is the first prospective real-world study assessing the impact of mepolizumab on clinical remission, providing valuable insights into clinical remission outcomes in patients with severe asthma who initiate mepolizumab therapy before irreversible disease progression. TRIAL REGISTRY: Trial registration number: ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06041386; GSK clinical trial registry: 219871.

papers.authors: Li C, Pan L, Min W

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Synovial sarcoma is a soft tissue malignancy with a well-known propensity for late recurrence. Pleural metastasis occurring more than five years after primary resection in the absence of pulmonary involvement is exceptionally rare. CASE PRESENTATION: A 42-year-old man underwent local excision of a right shoulder synovial sarcoma in 2019 without adjuvant therapy or follow-up. In June 2026, he presented with right-sided chest pain and progressive dyspnea. Contrast-enhanced chest computed tomography (CT) revealed a massive right pleural effusion with diffuse pleural thickening and no pulmonary nodules; the right shoulder, partially included in the scan field, showed postoperative changes without suspicious masses. Medical thoracoscopy demonstrated pleural adhesions and scattered miliary nodules. Pleural biopsy confirmed a spindle-cell neoplasm. The primary tumour exhibited a classic immunophenotype (Vimentin⁺, Bcl-2 partial⁺, CD99 partial⁺, CK individual⁺, Ki-67 8%). In striking contrast, the pleural metastasis showed a marked immunophenotypic shift: Bcl-2, CD99, and CK turned negative, with only diffuse Vimentin and weak EMA retained, while Ki-67 rose to 50%. After excluding primary pleural spindle-cell neoplasms, a diagnosis of presumed isolated pleural metastasis from synovial sarcoma was made. The patient was started on doxorubicin plus ifosfamide and achieved symptomatic relief sufficient for hospital discharge, but a second cycle could not be administered due to poor performance status. CONCLUSIONS: This case demonstrates that a dramatic immunophenotypic shift can occur during synovial sarcoma metastasis, posing a significant diagnostic pitfall. It suggests that extended pleural surveillance may be considered in long-term survivors of synovial sarcoma and highlights the importance of direct pathological comparison between primary and metastatic lesions when the immunoprofile appears atypical.

papers.authors: Yan D, Che J, Dai H, Guo L, Li J, Chen B, Gao Y, Wang H et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: National Key Laboratory of Intelligent Tracking and Forecasting for Infectious Diseases, National Institute for Communic…

GWAS analysis revealed that biofilm-associated phenotypic variation is a complex trait associated with multiple genetic factors spanning diverse biological processes. papers.reason: 为呼吸道病原体（百日咳）监测提供生物膜表型分布与候选基因关联数据，可作为微生物耐药/定植研究的方法学参考；不直接影响胸部肿瘤或胸外科的临床与科研决策。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Pertussis, an acute respiratory infection caused by Bordetella pertussis (B. pertussis), has resurged in China. Biofilm formation has recently been associated with the pathogenesis of B. pertussis. This study aims to analyze the biofilm formation capacity of circulating isolates and investigate the phenotype-genotype associations between biofilm formation and genomic characteristics. RESULTS: Among 84 B. pertussis isolates, 69.05% (58/84) were classified as strong biofilm formers, while 23.81% (20/84) and 5.95% (5/84) exhibited moderate or weak biofilm production, respectively. Only one isolate (1/84, 1.19%) was categorized as non-biofilm producers. Strong biofilm-forming isolates exhibited significantly faster autoagglutination than non-strong isolates (P < 0.05). Pan-GWAS identified multiple candidate genes significantly associated with biofilm phenotypes (P < 0.05), spanning functional categories related to cell envelope remodeling, metabolism, nutrient acquisition, substrate transport, and environmental sensing. SNP-GWAS further identified multiple core genome variants associated with biofilm-associated biomass variation (P < 0.05). Functional annotation of candidate loci indicated associations with lipoprotein maturation, autotransporter function, amino acid metabolism, and transport-related functions. Integration of pan-GWAS and SNP-GWAS identified candidate genetic factors associated with biofilm phenotypic heterogeneity in B. pertussis. CONCLUSIONS: Strong biofilm-forming isolates consistently exhibited higher levels of crystal-violet-stained attached biomass and faster aggregation kinetics than non-strong isolates. GWAS analysis revealed that biofilm-associated phenotypic variation is a complex trait associated with multiple genetic factors spanning diverse biological processes. These findings provide new insights into the phenotype-genotype association signatures of biofilm formation in circulating B. pertussis.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Immunoglobulin G4-related disease (IgG4-RD) is a systemic inflammatory disorder which typically presents as multiorgan infiltration by polyclonal IgG4-positive plasma cells and responds well to immunosuppression such as systemic corticosteroids. The co-occurrence of IgG4-RD among patients infected with HIV is extremely uncommon and has only been described in a few case reports. CASE PRESENTATION: We hereby present a 75-years old male with well controlled HIV, who presented with endobronchial mass ultimately diagnosed as IgG4-RD. He received multimodal treatment, which included both local bronchoscopic interventions (cryo-ablation and stent insertion) as well as systemic steroids, with an excellent therapeutic response. CONCLUSIONS: Our literature review identified 19 additional case reports of IgG4-RD among individuals with HIV, with significant heterogeneity in clinical presentation, organ involvement patterns, level of HIV control, and serum concentrations of IgG4. Most patients received specific therapy, including steroids, with generally favorable outcomes. This report highlights the possible occurrence of IgG4-RD in HIV patients, despite being immunocompromised, and the possibility of safely treating such cases with immunosuppressive medications.
